heading: Imposition of sanctions with respect to persons who engage in censorship or other forms of repression in Syria

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The President shall impose sanctions described in section 8791(c) of this title with respect to each person on the list required by subsection (b).

tree.heading: List of persons who engage in censorship

children.heading: In general
children.text: Not later than 120 days after August 10, 2012, the President shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a list of persons that the President determines have engaged in censorship, or activities relating to censorship, in a manner that prohibits, limits, or penalizes the legitimate exercise of freedom of expression by citizens of Syria.

children.heading: Updates of list
children.text: The President shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees an updated list under paragraph (1)—
not later than 300 days after August 10, 2012, and every 180 days thereafter; and

children.heading: Form
children.text: The list required by paragraph (1) shall be submitted in unclassified form but may contain a classified annex.

children.heading: Public availability
children.text: The unclassified portion of the list required by paragraph (1) shall be made available to the public and posted on the websites of the Department of the Treasury and the Department of State.

notes.heading: Termination of Section
notes.text: For termination of section, see section 8795 of this title.
